summary: The filing is a Form 6-K in which Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL) released a preliminary operational update for the second quarter of 2026, reporting a 7.2% increase in billed grid market and a 7.3% rise in electricity consumption, attributed to higher economic activity, customer base growth, and warmer temperatures. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or material corporate event is disclosed. The document consists entirely of routine operating metrics and forward-looking statements, with no special-situation elements such as M&A, capital returns, or management changes.
